title: Ndyuka-Tiriyó Pidgin - Wikipedia
text: Ndyuka-Trio Pidgin. Ndyuka-Tiriyó Pidgin (Ndyuka-Trio) was a trade language used until the 1960s between speakers of Ndyuka, an English-based creole, and Tiriyó and Wayana, both Cariban languages.
